u4-l1.mesto.note.en: Neuter: to mesto. The capital is **hlavné mesto**; Bratislava's historic centre is **Staré Mesto** (the Old Town).
u4-l1.mesto.note.t: Oʻrta jins: to mesto. Poytaxt — **hlavné mesto**; Bratislavaning tarixiy markazi — **Staré Mesto** (Eski shahar).

u4-l1.namestie.note.t: Oʻrta jins, xuddi mesto kabi: to námestie.

u4-l1.hrad-je-stary.note.en: After **je**, the adjective still matches the noun: hrad je star**ý**, dedina je star**á**, mesto je star**é**.
u4-l1.hrad-je-stary.note.t: Sifat **je** soʻzidan keyin ham otning jinsiga moslashadi: hrad je star**ý**, dedina je star**á**, mesto je star**é**.

u4-l1.fill-bratislava-je-hlavne.en.en: Bratislava is the capital of Slovakia.

u4-l1.fill-bratislava-je-hlavne.why.en: The capital is the set phrase **hlavné mesto**. Hlavné has the neuter ending -é, which already rules out dedina, a feminine word.
u4-l1.fill-bratislava-je-hlavne.why.t: Poytaxt — tayyor ibora: **hlavné mesto**. Hlavné oʻrta jins qoʻshimchasi -é bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun ayol jinsidagi dedina mos kelmaydi.

u4-l1.choice-most-je-novy.question.en: How do you say “The bridge is new”?

u4-l1.choice-most-je-novy.why.en: Most ends in a consonant, so it's masculine and the adjective takes **-ý**, after je too. Nová is for feminine words, nové for neuter ones.
u4-l1.choice-most-je-novy.why.t: Most undosh bilan tugaydi, demak erkak jinsida, sifat esa je soʻzidan keyin ham **-ý** oladi. Nová ayol jinsidagi, nové oʻrta jinsdagi soʻzlar uchun.

u4-l1.rieka.note.en: Bratislava's river is the **Dunaj** (the Danube). **dlhý** = long: dlh**á** rieka.

u4-l1.fill-dunaj-je-dlhy.why.en: Dunaj ends in a consonant, so it's masculine and takes **-ý**: dlh**ý**. Dlhá goes with rieka, which is feminine, but here the subject is Dunaj.
u4-l1.fill-dunaj-je-dlhy.why.t: Dunaj undosh bilan tugaydi, demak erkak jinsida va **-ý** oladi: dlh**ý**. Dlhá ayol jinsidagi rieka bilan keladi, lekin bu yerda gap Dunaj haqida.

u4-l1.build-mesto-je-male.prompt.en: The town is small and pretty.

en: Mesto ends in -o, so it's neuter and the adjective takes **-é**, after je too: mal**é**. Malá is for feminine nouns.
Both adjectives match mesto, which is neuter: pekn**é**, like malé. Pekný is for masculine nouns.
t: Mesto -o bilan tugaydi, demak oʻrta jinsda, sifat esa je soʻzidan keyin ham **-é** oladi: mal**é**. Malá ayol jinsidagi otlar uchun.
Ikkala sifat ham oʻrta jinsdagi mesto soʻziga moslashadi: pekn**é**, xuddi malé kabi. Pekný erkak jinsidagi otlar uchun.

u4-l1.vysoky.note.en: Like nový: vysok**ý** hrad, vysok**á** lampa, vysok**é** okno.
u4-l1.vysoky.note.t: Xuddi nový kabi: vysok**ý** hrad, vysok**á** lampa, vysok**é** okno.

u4-l1.choice-kostol-je-vysoky.question.en: Lucia says this. What is tall?

en: The castle is old and the church is new.
The castle is old and the church new.

u4-l2.prepacte-kde-je.en.en: Excuse me, where's the post office?

u4-l2.prepacte-kde-je.note.en: **Kde je…?** works for any place: Kde je **banka** (the bank)? Kde je **hotel**?
u4-l2.prepacte-kde-je.note.t: **Kde je…?** (… qayerda?) har qanday joy uchun ishlaydi: Kde je **banka** (bank)? Kde je **hotel** (mehmonxona)?

u4-l2.kaviaren.note.en: Feminine, even though it ends in a consonant: tá kaviareň. **káva** = coffee.
u4-l2.kaviaren.note.t: Undosh bilan tugasa ham, ayol jinsida: tá kaviareň. **káva** = qahva.

u4-l2.choice-kaviaren.question.en: Emma wants a coffee. Where does she go?
u4-l2.choice-kaviaren.question.t: Emma qahva ichmoqchi. U qayerga boradi?

u4-l2.muzeum.note.en: Kino, divadlo and múzeum are all neuter: to kino, to divadlo, to múzeum.
u4-l2.muzeum.note.t: Kino, divadlo va múzeum — hammasi oʻrta jinsda: to kino, to divadlo, to múzeum.

u4-l2.fill-prepacte-kde-je.why.en: Banka is one thing (ona), so the verb is **je**: Kde je…? works for any one place. Sú goes with oni, ony, and som with ja.
u4-l2.fill-prepacte-kde-je.why.t: Banka — bitta narsa (ona), shuning uchun feʼl **je**: Kde je…? har qanday bitta joy uchun ishlaydi. Sú oni, ony bilan, som esa ja bilan keladi.

u4-l2.dolava-doprava.note.en: Use these for directions, where to go. For where something is, you know **vľavo – vpravo**: Pošta je vľavo.
u4-l2.dolava-doprava.note.t: Bular yoʻnalish uchun: qayerga borish kerak. Narsa qayerda ekanini aytish uchun tanish **vľavo – vpravo** (chapda – oʻngda) ishlatiladi: Pošta je vľavo.

u4-l2.chodte-rovno-potom.note.en: **potom** = then. **Choďte** is for vy (strangers); to a friend: **Choď** rovno!
u4-l2.chodte-rovno-potom.note.t: **potom** = keyin. **Choďte** — «siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga (masalan, notanishga); doʻstingizga: **Choď** rovno!

u4-l2.choice-chodte-dolava.question.en: What does pán Kováč tell Emma?

u4-l2.listen-kino-je-vlavo.en.en: The cinema is on the left, the theatre is on the right.

en: Múzeum is one thing (ono), so the verb is **je**: Kde je…? works for any one place. Sú goes with oni, ony.
The museum is **múzeum**. Kino means cinema.
t: Múzeum — bitta narsa (ono), shuning uchun feʼl **je**: Kde je…? har qanday bitta joy uchun ishlaydi. Sú oni, ony bilan keladi.

u4-l2.fill-ahoj-tomas-chod.en.en: Hi Tomáš! Go straight on, then left.
u4-l2.fill-ahoj-tomas-chod.en.t: Salom, Tomash! Toʻgʻriga yur, keyin chapga.

u4-l2.fill-ahoj-tomas-chod.why.en: Ahoj and a first name mean a friend, so use the ty form **Choď**. Choďte is for vy: a stranger or a group.
u4-l2.fill-ahoj-tomas-chod.why.t: Ahoj va ism — demak doʻst, shuning uchun ty shakli: **Choď** (yur). Choďte (yuring) esa vy uchun: notanish odam yoki guruhga.

u4-l2.fill-muzeum-je-nove.why.en: Múzeum is neuter, like kino and divadlo, even though it ends in -um. So the adjective takes **-é**, after je too.
u4-l2.fill-muzeum-je-nove.why.t: Múzeum -um bilan tugasa ham, kino va divadlo kabi oʻrta jinsda. Shuning uchun sifat je soʻzidan keyin ham **-é** oladi.

en: The post office is opposite, the bank is on the left.

u4-l2.speak-prepacte-kde-je.en.en: Excuse me, where's the post office?

u4-l3.co-robis-som.en.en: What do you do? — I'm a cook.

u4-l3.co-robis-som.note.en: Marek, Lucia's brother, is a cook. To someone you call vy: Čo robíte?
u4-l3.co-robis-som.note.t: Lusiyaning akasi Marek oshpaz boʻlib ishlaydi. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Čo robíte?

en: Jobs work like študent → študent**ka**: most add **-ka** for a woman, kuchár → kuchár**ka**.
Jobs ending in **-ník** change to **-níčka**: čašník → čašní**čka**.
t: Oʻzbek tilida kasb nomi erkak uchun ham, ayol uchun ham bir xil. Slovak tilida esa ayol uchun alohida shakl bor: koʻpincha študent → študent**ka** kabi **-ka** qoʻshiladi: kuchár → kuchár**ka**.
**-ník** bilan tugaydigan kasblarda ayol shakli **-níčka** boʻladi: čašník → čašní**čka**.

en: Peter is a waiter and Jana is a waitress.

u4-l3.fill-ivan-je-casnik.en.en: Ivan is a waiter and Mária is a shop assistant.

u4-l3.fill-ivan-je-casnik.why.en: Mária is a woman, so the job takes the feminine **-ka**: predavač → predavač**ka**, like študent → študentka.
u4-l3.fill-ivan-je-casnik.why.t: Mariya — ayol, shuning uchun kasb nomi **-ka** bilan ayol shaklida keladi: predavač → predavač**ka**, xuddi študent → študentka kabi.

u4-l3.dochodca.note.en: A retired woman is dôchod**kyňa**: many words ending in -ca switch to **-kyňa**.
u4-l3.dochodca.note.t: Nafaqadagi ayol — dôchod**kyňa**: -ca bilan tugaydigan koʻp soʻzlarda ayol shakli **-kyňa** boʻladi.

u4-l3.mlady-stary.note.en: You know **starý** for things; it works for people too: mlad**á** študentka, star**ý** dôchodca.
u4-l3.mlady-stary.note.t: **starý** sizga narsalar haqida tanish (eski). U odamlar haqida ham ishlatiladi (keksa): mlad**á** študentka, star**ý** dôchodca.

en: Ona is a woman, so the job takes the feminine **-ka**: novinár**ka**. Novinár is for a man.
With **ona** (she), byť is **je**. Som goes with ja (I).
t: Gap ayol haqida (ona), shuning uchun kasb nomi **-ka** oladi: novinár**ka**. Novinár — erkak uchun; oʻzbekchada ikkalasi ham «jurnalist».
«U» — **ona**, ona bilan esa byť — **je**. Som ja (men) bilan keladi.

u4-l3.fill-pan-novak-nepracuje.en.en: Mr Novák doesn't work, he's a pensioner.

u4-l3.choice-co-robite.question.en: How do you ask a stranger what they do?

u4-l3.choice-co-robite.why.en: A stranger gets **vy**, so the verb ends in **-te**: robí**te**. Čo robíš? is for a friend (ty).
u4-l3.choice-co-robite.why.t: Notanish odamga **vy** (siz) deyiladi, shuning uchun feʼl **-te** bilan tugaydi: robí**te**. Čo robíš? — doʻstga (ty).

en: Tomáš is a programmer, not a driver.

u4-l3.listen-lucia-nie-je.en.en: Lucia isn't a waitress, she's a student.

en: In the plural, most masculine and feminine nouns end in **-y** (or **-e** after a soft sound like ň). Neuter nouns in -o end in **-á**, and those in -ie end in **-ia**.
“That” becomes **tie** for all of them, “is” becomes **sú**, and adjectives end in **-é**: tie mosty sú nov**é**.
t: Oʻzbek tilida koʻplik doim -lar bilan yasaladi, slovak tilida esa qoʻshimcha jinsga bogʻliq. Erkak va ayol jinsidagi otlarning koʻpchiligi **-y** bilan tugaydi (ň kabi yumshoq undoshdan keyin **-e**). -o bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jins otlari **-á**, -ie bilan tugaydiganlari **-ia** oladi.
«Oʻsha» soʻzi ularning hammasi uchun **tie** boʻladi, je oʻrniga **sú** keladi, sifatlar esa **-é** bilan tugaydi: tie mosty sú nov**é** (oʻsha koʻpriklar yangi).

u4-l4.fill-tie-kostoly-su.why.en: Tie and sú show it's more than one, and masculine kostol adds **-y** in the plural: kostol**y**.
u4-l4.fill-tie-kostoly-su.why.t: Tie va sú bir nechta narsa ekanini koʻrsatadi, erkak jinsidagi kostol esa koʻplikda **-y** oladi: kostol**y** (oʻzbekchadagi -lar oʻrnida).

u4-l4.fill-dediny-su-male.why.en: Dediny is plural, and in the plural adjectives for places and things end in **-é**. Malá is the singular: dedina je malá.
u4-l4.fill-dediny-su-male.why.t: Dediny — koʻplik, koʻplikda esa joy va narsalar haqidagi sifatlar **-é** bilan tugaydi. Malá — birlik: dedina je malá.

en: Námestia is plural, so “are” is **sú**. Je is for one thing: námestie je pekné.
In the plural, adjectives for places and things end in **-é**: pekn**é**. Pekný goes with one masculine noun.
The squares are more than one, and neuter nouns in -ie end in **-ia** in the plural: námesti**a**. Námestie is just one square.
t: Námestia — koʻplik, shuning uchun feʼl **sú**. Je bitta narsa uchun: námestie je pekné.
Koʻplikda joy va narsalar haqidagi sifatlar **-é** bilan tugaydi: pekn**é**. Pekný erkak jinsidagi bitta ot bilan keladi.
Maydonlar bittadan koʻp, -ie bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jins otlari esa koʻplikda **-ia** oladi: námesti**a** (oʻzbekchadagi -lar oʻrnida). Námestie — bitta maydon.

en: The cinemas and theatres are new.
Groups of men take **-i**: študent → študent**i**. A final k turns into c: čašník → čašní**ci**. Some words take **-ia** or **-ovia**.
For men, “that” is **tí** and adjectives end in **-í**: tí mladí kuchári. Women follow the pattern of things: tie mlad**é** kuchárky.
A mixed group of men and women counts as men.
t: Erkaklar guruhi uchun **-i** qoʻshiladi: študent → študent**i**. Oxirdagi k harfi c ga aylanadi: čašník → čašní**ci**. Baʼzi soʻzlar **-ia** yoki **-ovia** oladi.
Erkaklar haqida «oʻsha» — **tí**, sifatlar esa **-í** bilan tugaydi: tí mladí kuchári. Ayollar narsalar kabi oʻzgaradi: tie mlad**é** kuchárky.
Erkaklar va ayollardan iborat aralash guruh erkaklar kabi hisoblanadi.

u4-l4.fill-marek-a-peter.why.en: Marek and Peter are two men, so it's the men's plural in **-i**: kuchár**i**. Kuchárky is for women, kuchár for one man.
u4-l4.fill-marek-a-peter.why.t: Marek va Peter — ikki erkak, shuning uchun **-i** bilan erkaklar koʻpligi keladi: kuchár**i**. Kuchárky — ayollar uchun, kuchár — bitta erkak.

u4-l4.fill-ti-casnici-su.why.en: Čašníci are men, and in the plural adjectives for men end in **-í**, just like tí. Mladé is for women and things.
u4-l4.fill-ti-casnici-su.why.t: Čašníci — erkaklar, koʻplikda esa erkaklar haqidagi sifatlar **-í** bilan tugaydi, xuddi tí kabi. Mladé — ayollar va narsalar uchun.

u4-l4.choice-emma-a-lucia.question.en: How do you say “Emma and Lucia are students”?

u4-l4.choice-emma-a-lucia.why.en: Two women take the women's plural **-y**: študentk**y**, with sú. Študenti would mean men or a mixed group; je študentka is just one.
u4-l4.choice-emma-a-lucia.why.t: Ikki ayol uchun **-y** bilan ayollar koʻpligi keladi: študentk**y**, sú bilan birga. Študenti erkaklar yoki aralash guruhni bildiradi, je študentka esa bitta kishini.

u4-l4.build-tomas-a-marek.prompt.en: Tomáš and Marek are not journalists.

en: Tomáš and Marek are men, so the job takes the men's plural **-i**: novinár**i**. Novinárky is for women.
Tomáš and Marek are two people, oni, so byť is **sú**: nie sú. Je is for one person.
t: Tomash va Marek — erkaklar, shuning uchun **-i** bilan erkaklar koʻpligi keladi: novinár**i**. Novinárky — ayollar uchun.
Tomash va Marek — ikki kishi, oni, shuning uchun byť — **sú**: nie sú. Je bitta kishi uchun.

u4-l4.fill-lucia-a-tomas.why.en: A mixed group of men and women counts as men, so it takes the men's plural: Slovák → **Slováci**. Slovenky would mean women only.
u4-l4.fill-lucia-a-tomas.why.t: Erkaklar va ayollardan iborat aralash guruh erkaklar kabi hisoblanadi, shuning uchun erkaklar koʻpligi keladi: Slovák → **Slováci**. Slovenky faqat ayollarni bildiradi.

u4-l4.fill-tomas-a-marek-su-veseli.why.en: Tomáš and Marek are men, and in the plural adjectives for men end in **-í**: vesel**í**. Veselé is for women and things, veselý for one man.
u4-l4.fill-tomas-a-marek-su-veseli.why.t: Tomash va Marek — erkaklar, koʻplikda esa erkaklar haqidagi sifatlar **-í** bilan tugaydi: vesel**í**. Veselé ayollar va narsalar uchun, veselý esa bitta erkak uchun.

u4-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia-su-mile.why.en: Women follow the pattern of things, so in the plural the adjective ends in **-é**: mil**é**. Milí is for men, milá for one woman.
u4-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia-su-mile.why.t: Koʻplikda ayollar narsalar kabi oʻzgaradi, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: mil**é**. Milí erkaklar uchun, milá esa bitta ayol uchun.

u4-l4.choice-aki-su-marek.why.en: Marek and Peter are men, so the adjectives take the men's plural **-í**, like the question's ak**í**: siln**í**, vesel**í**. Je silný is about one man.
u4-l4.choice-aki-su-marek.why.t: Marek va Peter — erkaklar, shuning uchun sifatlar erkaklar koʻpligi qoʻshimchasi **-í** ni oladi, savoldagi ak**í** kabi: siln**í**, vesel**í**. Je silný esa bitta erkak haqida.

u4-l4.build-lucia-a-tomas-su.prompt.en: Lucia and Tomáš are cheerful and kind.
u4-l4.build-lucia-a-tomas-su.prompt.t: Lusiya va Tomash quvnoq va mehribon.

en: A mixed group of men and women counts as men, so the adjective takes the men's plural **-í**: vesel**í**.
Lucia and Tomáš are two people, oni, so byť is **sú**. Je is for one person.
t: Erkak va ayoldan iborat aralash guruh erkaklar kabi hisoblanadi, shuning uchun sifat erkaklar koʻpligi qoʻshimchasi **-í** ni oladi: vesel**í**.
Lusiya va Tomash — ikki kishi, oni (ular), shuning uchun byť — **sú**. Je bitta kishi uchun.

u4-rodina.moja-rodina.note.en: Emma is showing Lucia photos of her family in Ireland. **rodina** = family.
u4-rodina.moja-rodina.note.t: Emma Lusiyaga Irlandiyadagi oilasining suratlarini koʻrsatyapti. **rodina** = oila.

u4-rodina.mama-a-otec.note.en: Together they're your **rodičia** (parents), a plural word: To sú moji rodičia.
u4-rodina.mama-a-otec.note.t: Ikkalasi birga — **rodičia** (ota-ona), koʻplikdagi soʻz: To sú moji rodičia. = Bular mening ota-onam.

u4-rodina.brat-a-sestra.en.t: aka yoki uka; opa yoki singil

u4-rodina.brat-a-sestra.note.t: Slovakchada yosh farqi aytilmaydi: brat — aka ham, uka ham; sestra — opa ham, singil ham. Ular birgalikda **súrodenci** (aka-uka va opa-singillar).

u4-rodina.fill-lucia-je-marekova.why.en: Marek's takes the gender of what it describes. Sestra is feminine, so it ends in **-a**: Marekov**a**. Marekov goes with a masculine word: Marekov brat.
u4-rodina.fill-lucia-je-marekova.why.t: Oʻzbekchadagi -ning oʻzgarmaydi, Marekov esa oʻzidan keyingi otning jinsini oladi. Sestra ayol jinsida, shuning uchun **-a** bilan tugaydi: Marekov**a**. Marekov — erkak jinsi uchun: Marekov brat.

en: In the plural, môj, tvoj and náš work like tí and tie: **moji** for men or a mixed group, **moje** for women and things.
Some family words have their own plurals: brat → **bratia**, syn → **synovia**, dieťa → **deti**.
t: Koʻplikda môj (mening), tvoj (sening) va náš (bizning) xuddi tí va tie kabi oʻzgaradi: erkaklar yoki aralash guruh uchun **moji**, ayollar va narsalar uchun **moje**.
Oila haqidagi baʼzi soʻzlarning koʻpligi oʻziga xos: brat → **bratia**, syn → **synovia**, dieťa → **deti**.

en: Your brothers and sisters are cheerful.

u4-rodina.fill-to-su-moji.why.en: Bratia are men, so “my” takes the men's plural **moji**, like tí. Moje is for women and things, môj for one.
u4-rodina.fill-to-su-moji.why.t: Bratia — erkaklar, shuning uchun «mening» erkaklar koʻpligi shaklida keladi: **moji**, xuddi tí kabi. Moje ayollar va narsalar uchun, môj esa bitta uchun.

u4-rodina.manzel-a-manzelka.note.en: Women's surnames add **-ová**: pán Horváth, pani Horváth**ová**. Pani Horváthová's husband is pán Horváth.
u4-rodina.manzel-a-manzelka.note.t: Ayollar familiyasiga **-ová** qoʻshiladi, oʻzbekchadagi Karimov — Karimova kabi: pán Horváth, pani Horváth**ová**. Horvatova xonimning eri — janob Horvat.

u4-rodina.zenaty-vydata.en.en: married (of a man / of a woman)

u4-rodina.zenaty-vydata.note.en: Slovak has a word for each: a man is **ženatý**, a woman **vydatá**. Single: **slobodný**, **slobodná**.
u4-rodina.zenaty-vydata.note.t: Slovakchada ham, oʻzbekchadagi kabi, har biri uchun alohida soʻz bor: erkak — **ženatý**, ayol — **vydatá**. Turmush qurmagan: **slobodný**, **slobodná**.

u4-rodina.choice-tomas-nie-je.question.en: Tomáš isn't married. What does he say?

u4-rodina.choice-tomas-nie-je.why.en: A married man is **ženatý**, so Tomáš says nie som ženatý. Vydatá is only for women, and nie som slobodný means “I'm not single”.
u4-rodina.choice-tomas-nie-je.why.t: Uylangan erkak — **ženatý**, shuning uchun Tomash nie som ženatý deydi. Vydatá faqat ayollar uchun, nie som slobodný esa «boʻydoq emasman» degani.

en: Mum and dad together are a mixed group, which counts as men, so “my” is **moji**. Moje goes with women and things: moje sestry.
Rodičia is plural, oni, so byť is **sú**. Je is for one person.
t: Ona va ota birgalikda aralash guruh, u erkaklar kabi hisoblanadi, shuning uchun «mening» — **moji**. Moje ayollar va narsalar bilan keladi: moje sestry.
Rodičia — koʻplik, oni (ular), shuning uchun byť — **sú**. Je bitta kishi uchun.

u4-rodina.listen-moja-sestra-je.en.en: My sister is cheerful and kind.

u4-rodina.fill-to-su-moje.why.en: **Moje** is the plural for women and things, so it goes with sestr**y**. Brothers would take moji: moji bratia. Sestra is just one sister.
u4-rodina.fill-to-su-moje.why.t: **Moje** — ayollar va narsalar uchun koʻplik shakli, shuning uchun sestr**y** bilan keladi. Aka-ukalar uchun moji boʻlardi: moji bratia. Sestra esa bitta opa yoki singil.

en: Mrs Horváthová is married and her son is a journalist.
Mrs Horváthová is married and her son is a reporter.
t: Horvatova xonim turmushga chiqqan va uning oʻgʻli jurnalist.
Horvatova xonim turmushga chiqqan va oʻgʻli jurnalist.
Horvatova xonim turmushga chiqqan, uning oʻgʻli jurnalist.
Horvatova xonim turmushga chiqqan, oʻgʻli jurnalist.

en: After 2, 3 and 4, use the plural you just learned: dva most**y**, tri mest**á**.
Two has two forms: **dva** for masculine words, **dve** for feminine and neuter ones. For things, **tri** and **štyri** stay the same.
**tu** = here, **tam** = there. Tu sú dva hotely. = There are two hotels here.
t: Oʻzbek tilida sondan keyin ot birlikda keladi (ikki koʻprik). Slovak tilida esa 2, 3 va 4 dan keyin hozirgina oʻrgangan koʻplik shakli keladi: dva most**y**, tri mest**á**.
«Ikki»ning ikki shakli bor: erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar uchun **dva**, ayol va oʻrta jinsdagilar uchun **dve**. Narsalar uchun **tri** va **štyri** oʻzgarmaydi.
**tu** = bu yerda, **tam** = u yerda. Tu sú dva hotely. = Bu yerda ikkita mehmonxona bor.

u4-l5.fill-mesto-ma-dva.why.en: You're counting bridges, and most is masculine, so two is **dva**. Dve is for feminine and neuter words like mesto, but mesto isn't what's counted.
u4-l5.fill-mesto-ma-dva.why.t: Koʻpriklar sanalyapti, most esa erkak jinsida, shuning uchun «ikki» — **dva**. Dve ayol va oʻrta jins uchun; mesto oʻrta jinsda, lekin sanalayotgan narsa u emas.

u4-l5.fill-tu-su-dve.why.en: Kaviareň is feminine, even though it ends in a consonant, so two is **dve**. Dva is only for masculine words.
u4-l5.fill-tu-su-dve.why.t: Kaviareň undosh bilan tugasa ham, ayol jinsida, shuning uchun «ikki» — **dve**. Dva faqat erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar uchun.

u4-l5.choice-dve-mesta.why.en: Mesto is neuter, so two is **dve**, and after 2, 3 and 4 the noun is plural: mest**á**.
u4-l5.choice-dve-mesta.why.t: Mesto oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «ikki» — **dve**. 2, 3 va 4 dan keyin ot oʻzbekchadagidek birlikda emas, koʻplikda keladi: mest**á**.

en: Mosty are things, and for things four stays **štyri**. Štyria is only for counting men.
After 2, 3 and 4 the noun is plural, so most adds **-y**: štyri most**y**.
Four bridges are more than one, so “are” is **sú**, as in Tu sú dva hotely. Je is for one thing.
t: Mosty — narsalar, narsalar uchun esa «toʻrt» — **štyri**. Štyria faqat erkaklarni sanash uchun.
2, 3 va 4 dan keyin ot koʻplikda keladi, shuning uchun most **-y** oladi: štyri most**y**. Oʻzbekchada esa sondan keyin birlik: toʻrtta koʻprik.
Toʻrtta koʻprik bittadan koʻp, shuning uchun «bor» oʻrnida **sú** keladi, xuddi Tu sú dva hotely kabi. Je bitta narsa uchun.

en: When you count men (or a mixed group), 2, 3 and 4 change to **dvaja**, **traja**, **štyria**, and the noun takes the men's plural: dvaja kuchár**i**.
t: Erkaklarni (yoki aralash guruhni) sanaganda 2, 3 va 4 oʻrniga **dvaja**, **traja**, **štyria** ishlatiladi, ot esa erkaklar koʻpligi shaklida boʻladi: dvaja kuchár**i**.
Ayollar va narsalar uchun esa **dve** (yoki **dva**), **tri**, **štyri** qoladi.

u4-l5.fill-tam-su-dvaja.en.en: There are two waiters over there.

u4-l5.fill-tam-su-dvaja.why.en: When you count men, two is **dvaja**, and the noun takes the men's plural: čašníci. Dva is for masculine things, like dva mosty.
u4-l5.fill-tam-su-dvaja.why.t: Erkaklarni sanaganda «ikki» — **dvaja**, ot esa erkaklar koʻpligida keladi: čašníci. Dva — erkak jinsidagi narsalar uchun, masalan dva mosty.

u4-l5.fill-lucia-ma-tri.why.en: Kamarátky are women, and women keep **tri**. Traja is only for men or a mixed group.
u4-l5.fill-lucia-ma-tri.why.t: Kamarátky — ayollar, ayollar bilan esa **tri** oʻzgarmaydi. Traja faqat erkaklar yoki aralash guruh uchun.

u4-l5.choice-traja-kuchari.why.en: Counting men takes **traja**, with the men's plural kuchári. Women keep tri: tri kuchárky. So tri kuchári and traja kuchárky both mix the two.
u4-l5.choice-traja-kuchari.why.t: Erkaklarni sanaganda **traja** va erkaklar koʻpligi kuchári keladi. Ayollar bilan tri qoladi: tri kuchárky. Tri kuchári va traja kuchárky ikkalasini aralashtirib yuboradi.

u4-l5.build-dvaja-casnici-a.prompt.t: Ikkita ofitsiant yigit va ikkita ofitsiant qiz.

en: For women, two is **dve**: dve čašníčky. Dva is for masculine things, like dva mosty, and men take dvaja: dvaja čašníci.
The sentence counts two, so men take **dvaja** and women **dve**. Traja means three, and only for men.
t: Ayollar uchun «ikki» — **dve**: dve čašníčky. Dva erkak jinsidagi narsalar uchun (dva mosty), erkaklar uchun esa dvaja: dvaja čašníci.
Gapda ikki kishi sanalyapti: erkaklar uchun **dvaja**, ayollar uchun dve. Traja «uch» degani va faqat erkaklar uchun.

en: The town has two hotels and three cafés.
t: Shaharda ikkita mehmonxona va uchta kafe bor.
Shaharda uchta kafe va ikkita mehmonxona bor.

en: **Koľko to stojí?** means “How much is it?” The verb **stáť** means “to cost”, and also “to stand”.
One thing **stojí**, two or more things **stoja**.
t: **Koľko to stojí?** = «Bu qancha turadi?» **stáť** feʼli ham oʻzbekcha «turmoq» kabi ikki maʼnoli: narxi boʻlmoq va tik turmoq.
Bitta narsa **stojí**, ikki va undan ortiq narsa **stoja**.

en: Emma and Lucia are standing at the front.
**Euro** is neuter, so two is **dve**: dve eur**á**.
From five up, Slovak uses a special short form: päť **eur**, desať **eur**.
t: **Euro** oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «ikki» — **dve**: dve eur**á**.
Beshdan boshlab slovak tilida maxsus qisqa shakl ishlatiladi: päť **eur**, desať **eur**.

u4-l6.fill-kolko-to-stoji.why.en: To (it) is one thing, so the verb is **stojí**. Stoja is for two or more things, stojím for ja.
u4-l6.fill-kolko-to-stoji.why.t: To (bu) — bitta narsa, shuning uchun feʼl **stojí**. Stoja ikki va undan ortiq narsa uchun, stojím esa ja uchun.

u4-l6.fill-mobil-stoji-sto.en.en: The phone costs a hundred euros.

u4-l6.fill-mobil-stoji-sto.why.en: The verb agrees with mobil, one thing, not with the euros: mobil **stojí**. Stoja is for two or more things.
u4-l6.fill-mobil-stoji-sto.why.t: Feʼl yevrolarga emas, bitta narsaga — mobil soʻziga moslashadi: mobil **stojí**. Stoja ikki va undan ortiq narsa uchun.

u4-l6.choice-pat-eur.why.en: From five up, euro takes the special short form **eur**. Eurá is only for 2, 3 and 4.
u4-l6.choice-pat-eur.why.t: Beshdan boshlab euro maxsus qisqa shaklda keladi: **eur**. Eurá faqat 2, 3 va 4 bilan ishlatiladi.

en: The verb agrees with káva, one thing, not with the euros: káva **stojí**. Stoja is for two or more things.
After 2, 3 and 4, euro takes **eurá**. The short form eur is for five and up: päť eur.
Euros are things, so three is **tri**: tri eurá. Traja is only for counting men.
t: Feʼl yevrolarga emas, bitta narsa — káva soʻziga moslashadi: káva **stojí**. Stoja ikki va undan ortiq narsa uchun.
2, 3 va 4 dan keyin euro **eurá** boʻladi. Qisqa eur shakli beshdan boshlab keladi: päť eur.
Yevro — narsa, shuning uchun «uch» — **tri**: tri eurá. Traja faqat erkaklarni sanash uchun.

u4-l6.listen-tomas-stoji-vzadu.en.en: Tomáš is standing at the back.

u4-l6.fill-my-stojime-tu.why.en: With **my** (we) the verb ends in **-me**: stojí**me**. Stojíte goes with vy, stoja with oni.
u4-l6.fill-my-stojime-tu.why.t: **my** (biz) bilan feʼl **-me** bilan tugaydi: stojí**me** (turibmiz). Stojíte vy bilan, stoja esa oni bilan keladi.

en: Some nouns exist only in the plural, even for one thing: **nohavice** (trousers), **okuliare** (glasses), **noviny** (a newspaper).

They always take plural forms, even where English uses the singular: Noviny **sú** nové. = The newspaper is new. Hodinky **stoja** päť eur. = The watch costs five euros. Words that go with them are plural too: **moje** hodinky = my watch.
t: Baʼzi otlar bitta narsa haqida gapirilganda ham faqat koʻplikda boʻladi: **nohavice** (shim), **okuliare** (koʻzoynak), **noviny** (gazeta).

Ular bilan doim koʻplik shakllari ishlatiladi, oʻzbek tilida birlik boʻlsa ham: Noviny **sú** nové. = Gazeta yangi. Hodinky **stoja** päť eur. = Soat besh yevro turadi. Ular bilan keladigan soʻzlar ham koʻplikda boʻladi: **moje** hodinky = mening soatim.

u4-l6.fill-tie-nohavice-su.why.en: Nohavice is always plural, even for one pair of trousers, so it takes **sú**. Tie and drahé are plural too.
u4-l6.fill-tie-nohavice-su.why.t: Nohavice bitta shim boʻlsa ham doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun **sú** bilan keladi. Tie va drahé ham koʻplikda.

u4-l6.fill-okuliare-stoja-desat.why.en: Okuliare is always plural, even for one pair of glasses, so the verb is plural too: **stoja**.
u4-l6.fill-okuliare-stoja-desat.why.t: Okuliare bitta koʻzoynak boʻlsa ham doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun feʼl ham koʻplikda keladi: **stoja**.

en: Hodinky (watch) is always plural, even for one watch, so the verb is **sú**. Je is for ordinary singular words.
Hodinky is always plural, so “my” is plural too: **moje** hodinky. Môj goes with one masculine thing.
Words that go with hodinky are plural, since it's always plural: **moje**. Moja is for one feminine thing.
t: Hodinky bitta soat boʻlsa ham doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun feʼl ham koʻplikda: **sú**. Je oddiy birlikdagi soʻzlar bilan keladi.
Hodinky doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun «mening» ham koʻplikda: **moje** hodinky. Môj erkak jinsidagi bitta narsa bilan keladi.
Hodinky doim koʻplikda, shuning uchun u bilan keladigan soʻzlar ham koʻplikda boʻladi: **moje**. Moja ayol jinsidagi bitta narsa uchun.

u4-l7.choice-chodte-rovno-potom.question.en: What are you told to do?

u4-l7.fill-prepacte-kde-je.en.en: Excuse me, where's the post office? — It's opposite.

u4-l7.fill-prepacte-kde-je.why.en: With **je** you ask about one place, so use the basic form **pošta**. Pošty is the plural and would need sú.
u4-l7.fill-prepacte-kde-je.why.t: **je** bilan bitta joy haqida soʻraladi, shuning uchun asosiy shakl keladi: **pošta**. Pošty — koʻplik, u bilan sú kerak boʻlardi.

u4-l7.build-marek-je-kuchar.prompt.en: Marek is a cook and Lucia is a student.

en: Marek is a man, so it's **kuchár**, with no ending. Kuchárka, with -ka, is for a woman.
Lucia is a woman, so the job adds **-ka**: študent**ka**. Študent is for a man.
t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun qoʻshimchasiz **kuchár**. -ka bilan kuchárka esa ayol uchun.
Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun kasb nomiga **-ka** qoʻshiladi: študent**ka**. Študent erkak uchun.

u4-l7.fill-tie-kaviarne-su.why.en: Kaviarne is a plural of things, so the adjective ends in **-é**. Drahí is only for men, drahá for one feminine thing.
u4-l7.fill-tie-kaviarne-su.why.t: Kaviarne — narsalar koʻpligi, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi. Drahí faqat erkaklar uchun, drahá esa ayol jinsidagi bitta narsa uchun.

u4-l7.fill-ti-novinari-su.why.en: Novinári are men, so in the plural the adjective ends in **-í**, matching tí. Mladé is for women and things.
u4-l7.fill-ti-novinari-su.why.t: Novinári — erkaklar, shuning uchun koʻplikda sifat **-í** bilan tugaydi, xuddi tí kabi. Mladé — ayollar va narsalar uchun.

u4-l7.choice-traja-casnici.why.en: Counting men takes **traja**, and the noun takes the men's plural: čašník → čašní**ci**.
u4-l7.choice-traja-casnici.why.t: Erkaklarni sanaganda **traja** keladi, ot esa erkaklar koʻpligida boʻladi: čašník → čašní**ci**.

u4-l7.build-mesto-ma-tri.prompt.en: The town has three churches and two theatres.
u4-l7.build-mesto-ma-tri.prompt.t: Shaharda uchta cherkov va ikkita teatr bor.

en: Divadlo is neuter, so two is **dve**: dve divadlá. Dva is only for masculine words, like dva kostoly.
After 2, 3 and 4 the noun is plural, so kostol adds **-y**: tri kostol**y**.
t: Divadlo oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun «ikki» — **dve**: dve divadlá. Dva faqat erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar uchun, masalan dva kostoly.
2, 3 va 4 dan keyin ot koʻplikda keladi, shuning uchun kostol **-y** oladi: tri kostol**y**.

u4-l7.fill-kolko-stoja-tie.why.en: Okuliare only exists in the plural, so even one pair takes the plural verb **stoja**. Stojí is for one thing.
u4-l7.fill-kolko-stoja-tie.why.t: Okuliare faqat koʻplikda boʻladi, shuning uchun bitta koʻzoynak ham koʻplikdagi **stoja** bilan keladi. Stojí — bitta narsa uchun.

u4-l7.choice-nohavice.why.en: **Nohavice** is plural only: one pair of trousers still takes sú and stoja. Kaviareň and rieka are ordinary feminine words, with plurals kaviarne and rieky.
u4-l7.choice-nohavice.why.t: **Nohavice** faqat koʻplikda: bitta shim ham sú va stoja bilan keladi. Kaviareň va rieka — oddiy ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar, koʻpligi kaviarne va rieky.

u4-l7.build-most-je-novy.prompt.en: The bridge is new and the castle is old.

en: Most ends in a consonant, so it's masculine and the adjective takes **-ý**: nov**ý**. Nové is for neuter nouns.
Hrad is masculine (it ends in a consonant), so the adjective takes **-ý**: star**ý**. Stará is for feminine nouns.
t: Most undosh bilan tugaydi, demak erkak jinsida, sifat esa **-ý** oladi: nov**ý**. Nové oʻrta jinsdagi otlar uchun.
Hrad erkak jinsida (undosh bilan tugaydi), shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: star**ý**. Stará ayol jinsidagi otlar uchun.
